read.args.path.description: Path, URL, or internal URI to read (append :sel for line ranges or raw mode, e.g. src/foo.ts:50-100)

models.args.pattern.description: Filter/search substring, or provider name (required for find)

models.flags.config.description: Load an extra config.yml-style overlay for this run (repeatable)
dry-balance.args.model.description: Model selector (provider/model or fuzzy id). Defaults to the configured default model.
